BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tsôwq where it means distress, a strait. In Proverbs 1:27, distress and anguish cometh upon you, and it appears again in Isaiah 8:22.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsôwq exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
